title: NGT Signs Iconicity Ratings
descriptions: This dataset contains iconicity ratings and response times for 415 signs in NGT (Sign Language of the Netherlands/Dutch Sign Language). There are five documents in this repository: (1) Iconicity ratings (2) Response times (3) Summary description of participants (4) Questionnaire (5) Instruction videos in NGT The documents (1) and (2) contain data from the same 23 deaf signers. Response times are for the iconicity ratings. The videos referred to in the CSV files are in a separate repository, "NGT video stimuli, with and without mouth actions" here: https://doi.org/10.17026/SS/CNQGSY
